_about: 2028 seat model v2.2 (.build/analysis/seat-model/swing-simulate.mjs), mode nowcast: 20,000 simulated elections. Logit swing from 2025 with seat terms fitted on 1996-2025 (sitting members, defections, reversion of each seat's 2025 surprise); preferences replayed on each division's 2025 Senate rankings (House-calibrated; the Coalition's Labor-v-One Nation and One Nation's Labor-v-Coalition levels set to the site's flow tables); fitted polling, state, seat-type, education, seat and flow errors. Nowcast: an election held now, final-month polling error, no fade. HARD LIMITS: the 2025 candidate field is assumed (W6); independents' votes carry over with noise; how-to-vote decisions are not modelled beyond the 2025 Senate-to-House offsets (a Coalition card putting Labor above One Nation would move many seats); intervals are floor, not ceiling.

national.headline: Labor would probably win the most seats, more likely short of a majority than not
